from pathlib import Path
def replace(p, old, new):
    p=Path(p); s=p.read_text(); assert s.count(old)==1,(p,old,s.count(old)); p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
p='lib/ipo_profile/src/IpoGraph.h'

','Rf433BinarySocket, GpioRelay, PwmChannel, ModbusRelay, ShellyMeter
')

','Temperature, Humidity, Co2, UnixTime, Illuminance, SoilMoisture, Switch, Duty,
  ActivePower, Energy
')

')

    case Driver::ShellyMeter: return channel == Channel::ActivePower || channel == Channel::Energy;')
replace(p,'    case SignalRole::SubstrateMoisture: return channel == Channel::SoilMoisture;','    case SignalRole::SubstrateMoisture: return channel == Channel::SoilMoisture;
    case SignalRole::ActivePower: return channel == Channel::ActivePower;
    case SignalRole::Energy: return channel == Channel::Energy;')
p='src/climate/runtime/profile/IpoProfileJsonDecode.cpp'
replace(p,'{"modbus.relay", Driver::ModbusRelay},','{"modbus.relay", Driver::ModbusRelay}, {"shelly.meter", Driver::ShellyMeter},')

  {"active_power_w", Channel::ActivePower}, {"energy_wh", Channel::Energy},')
replace(p,'{"substrate.moisture_pct", SignalRole::SubstrateMoisture},','{"substrate.moisture_pct", SignalRole::SubstrateMoisture},
  {"electrical.active_power_w", SignalRole::ActivePower}, {"electrical.energy_wh", SignalRole::Energy},')
# No physical Shelly locator admission: draft-only, same as existing unsupported drivers.
p='schemas/device-profile.v2.schema.json'
replace(p,'              "modbus.relay"
','              "modbus.relay",
              "shelly.meter"
')
replace(p,'              "substrate.moisture_pct"
','              "substrate.moisture_pct",
              "electrical.active_power_w",
              "electrical.energy_wh"
')
p='web/src/domain/ipo-catalog.ts'
replace(p,'  "substrate.moisture_pct": { label: "Wilgotność podłoża", unit: "percent" },','  "substrate.moisture_pct": { label: "Wilgotność podłoża", unit: "percent" },
  "electrical.active_power_w": { label: "Moc czynna", unit: "W" },
  "electrical.energy_wh": { label: "Energia", unit: "Wh" },')
replace(p,'  | "rf433.binary_socket" | "gpio.relay" | "pwm.channel" | "modbus.relay"','  | "rf433.binary_socket" | "gpio.relay" | "pwm.channel" | "modbus.relay" | "shelly.meter"')
replace(p,'transport: "ble" | "i2c" | "rf433" | "gpio" | "pwm" | "modbus" | "adc"','transport: "ble" | "i2c" | "rf433" | "gpio" | "pwm" | "modbus" | "adc" | "shelly"')
replace(p,'  "modbus.relay": { label: "Przekaźnik Modbus", transport: "modbus", status: "proposed", channels: [output("switch", "binary")] },','  "modbus.relay": { label: "Przekaźnik Modbus", transport: "modbus", status: "proposed", channels: [output("switch", "binary")] },
  "shelly.meter": { label: "Shelly — pomiary", transport: "shelly", status: "proposed", channels: [input("active_power_w", "W"), input("energy_wh", "Wh")] },')
replace(p,'  const type = DRIVER_CATALOG[driver].transport','  const type = DRIVER_CATALOG[driver].transport
  if (type === "shelly") return /^shelly:[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$/.test(locator)')
p='web/src/domain/ipo-profile.ts'
replace(p,'SCD41 T/RH: kanał istnieje w sensorze, lecz firmware dziś używa z SCD41 tylko CO₂.','SCD41 T/RH: dostępne w warstwie wejść; alternatywne przypisania pozostają szkicem bez kwalifikacji sprzętowej i aktywacji.')
p='web/src/domain/ipo-board-readiness.test.ts'
replace(p,'  it("requires physical RF dwell budgets even for otherwise valid graphs", () => {',"  it("supports optional electrical observations as draft inputs only", () => {
    const p = createDefaultIpoProfile()
    p.devices.push({
      id: "meter_1", label: "Shelly", driver: "shelly.meter",
      locator: "shelly:meter_1", enabled: true,
    })
    p.signals.push(
      { role: "electrical.active_power_w", sources: [{ device_id: "meter_1", channel: "active_power_w" }] },
      { role: "electrical.energy_wh", sources: [{ device_id: "meter_1", channel: "energy_wh" }] },
    )
    expect(validateIpoProfile(p)).toEqual([])
    expect(assessCrowPanelProfile(p).matchesCurrentFirmware).toBe(false)
    expect(assessCrowPanelProfile(p).applyEnabled).toBe(false)
    p.signals[p.signals.length - 1].sources[0].channel = "active_power_w"
    expect(validateIpoProfile(p).length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
  })

"+'  it("requires physical RF dwell budgets even for otherwise valid graphs", () => {')
p='test/test_ipo_profile/test_main.cpp'
replace(p,'void testSymbolicOnlyArbitration() {',"void testOptionalElectricalChannelsRemainDraftOnly() {
  auto graph = ipo::makeCrowPanelMintReferenceGraph();
  graph.devices[graph.device_count++] = {42U, ipo::Driver::ShellyMeter, 1U, true};
  graph.signals[graph.signal_count++] = {
      ipo::SignalRole::ActivePower, 42U, ipo::Channel::ActivePower, 0U};
  graph.signals[graph.signal_count++] = {
      ipo::SignalRole::Energy, 42U, ipo::Channel::Energy, 0U};
  assert(ipo::validateGraph(graph) == ipo::GraphStatus::Ok);
  ipo::InputReadingRegistry frame(graph);
  assert(!frame.select(ipo::SignalRole::ActivePower, 30000U).usable());
  assert(frame.record({42U, ipo::Channel::ActivePower, 0.0, 1U, true}));
  assert(frame.record({42U, ipo::Channel::Energy, 150.0, 1U, true}));
  assert(frame.select(ipo::SignalRole::ActivePower, 30000U).usable());
  assert(frame.select(ipo::SignalRole::Energy, 30000U).value == 150.0);
  assert(!frame.select(ipo::SignalRole::Energy, 0U).usable());
  const auto admission = ipo::assessCrowPanelReference(graph);
  assert(!admission.matches_compiled_board && !admission.apply_authorized);
  graph.signals[graph.signal_count - 1U].channel = ipo::Channel::ActivePower;
  assert(ipo::validateGraph(graph) == ipo::GraphStatus::ChannelMismatch);
  assert(!ipo::driverProvides(ipo::Driver::ShellyMeter, ipo::Channel::Switch));
}

"+'void testSymbolicOnlyArbitration() {')
replace(p,'  testSymbolicOnlyArbitration();','  testOptionalElectricalChannelsRemainDraftOnly();
  testSymbolicOnlyArbitration();')
